The site pops up a name/email/phone enquiry form on load and the brochure is behind it - I did not fill it in and did not fetch anything behind it; the popup artwork /assets/images/popup/popupimg.jpg is excluded as furniture. Images are served from the developer's own WordPress backend at api.imandevelopers.com. The small amenity PNGs under /uploads/2025/04/ and /2025/05/ (Rooftop-Gym.png etc.) were measured at around 90x68 and are pictogram icons, so they are excluded. I downloaded and LOOKED at every image listed here. Careful with the filenames on this page: 15 Cascade's gallery files are exterior-1-2.JPG, exterior-2-2.JPG, exterior-3-3.JPG, while One Park Central publishes exterior-1-2.WEBP and exterior-2-2.WEBP - same stems, different files, different projects. FILENAME WARNINGS: exterior-3-3 is a sunset pool deck, not a building exterior; and 15-cascade.jpg, the file named after the project, is a photograph of the live construction site (raft pour, concrete pumps, rebar), not a render. No floor plans are published as images on this page.
